tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List public RemixMeme templates. Optional query, category, limit (max 100), and offset. Does not return generation prompts.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get one public RemixMeme template by slug. Does not return generation prompts.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Return the credit balance for the API key owner.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Start a RemixMeme generation using the same credits as the website. consent must be true and attests that the caller has rights to the media and will not generate sexual or exploitative content involving minors. Provide template_slug and/or prompt. Does not return hidden template prompt text.

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Poll one of your RemixMeme generations by id.
